The U.S. Army successfully completed a controlled detonation of nearly five tons of lead-based explosives in Iowa, reporting promising initial lead readings.
Stock market indices declined following an Nvidia-led tech sell-off, driven by concerns over AI spending, inflation, and the risks of higher interest rates.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower on November 24, as an Nvidia-led tech sell-off impacted markets. Investors weighed concerns over AI spending, persistent inflation, and the risks of higher interest rates.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield fell on November 25, despite sticky inflation data, as investors bought bonds for protection.

vix.why: The VIX decreased on November 24, as options trading suggested expectations for dampening stock swings in the near term.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate decreased by 0.07% in the weekly survey released November 25, tracking the recent slide in the 10-year Treasury yield, which investors sought for protection.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations for verifying eligible status.
policy_upcoming.effect: You must verify U.S. citizenship or eligible immigration status if you apply for housing assistance under a covered program.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations for verifying eligible status.
policy_week.effect: You must verify U.S. citizenship or eligible immigration status if you apply for housing assistance under a covered program.

policy_week.what_happened: Final regulations provide guidance for automatic enrollment requirements that apply to certain retirement plans.
policy_week.effect: Your retirement plan participation is subject to new automatic enrollment requirements starting January 19, 2027.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA set the 2027 baseline conforming loan limit at $855,400 for one-unit homes, announced Nov 24
policy_calendar.note: Up $22,650 from 2026. It applies to loans made from January 1, 2027, and is the line between a conforming mortgage and a jumbo one in most of the US. High-cost counties have higher limits on FHFA's county list.

tech.summary: SpaceX has received approval from the FCC to deploy up to one million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of its "Starmind" initiative, aiming to establish orbital data centers.
Nothing has provided a detailed look at its upcoming AI earbuds, the Ear Note, which feature call recording, transcription, and summarization capabilities, with a microphone-equipped charging case.

A new preprint article suggests that the polynomial Hirsch conjecture, a long-standing open problem in mathematics and theoretical computer science related to the diameter of polytopes, has been found to be false.

world.summary: Colombian security forces stormed a supermarket in Cartagena, ending a daylong siege and successfully rescuing all hostages, though one man described by police as a hostage-taker was killed.
Israeli judges have recommended dropping the most serious charges against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, indicating there is little chance of conviction in one of his three ongoing cases.
The Bank of England has warned that food price inflation in the UK could reach 5% next year, as cost pressures continue to mount despite recent increases being less severe than initially feared.
Ukraine has claimed that its Blysk laser system successfully intercepted and downed a Russian jet-powered drone in combat, marking what it describes as a world first for this technology.

us.summary: The U.S. Army successfully completed a controlled detonation of nearly five tons of unstable lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant, with officials reporting promising initial lead readings in the area.
Kilmar Ábrego García, a Salvadoran national who became a symbol of past deportation efforts, voluntarily departed the U.S. for Spain following a nearly two-year legal battle.
Inspections over two years at four Butterball plants, the nation's largest turkey producer, found high levels of salmonella bacteria in more than a third of its ground or chopped turkey samples.

science.summary: The NHS has launched the world's largest trial to investigate whether artificial intelligence can improve the early diagnosis of breast cancer and potentially ease pressure on healthcare services.
Doctors are facing challenges in saving newborns from a rare but devastating bleeding disorder, as some parents are refusing routine vitamin K shots due to the spread of misinformation.
